_comment: Merge the 'mcpServers' block below into your existing claude_desktop_config.json. Location: macOS '~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json', Windows '%APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json'. Edit via Claude Desktop Settings > Developer > Edit Config, or by hand, then fully restart the app. See ../README.md for per-server setup notes and caveats.

cognition._note: Lane 2 (cognition/thinking). Already built by this repo's Claude Code setup at this exact path — reused as-is, no separate build needed. If that path doesn't exist on your machine, build it from mcp/cognition-mcp/ in ORCA-OS with 'npm install && npm run build' and point 'args' at the resulting dist/index.js.

sequential-thinking._note: Lane 2. Official Anthropic reference server, runs on-demand via npx, nothing to build.

rvry._note: Lane 2. Backs the deepthink/problem-solve skills' escalation mode. Run 'npx @rvry/mcp setup' once yourself first (per its own installer) to authenticate/configure — that setup step may rewrite this block; treat this entry as a starting point, not a guarantee of exact args.

chrome-devtools._note: Lane 1 (research/scraping). Browser automation for the research and clone-website skills.

context7._note: Lane 1. Live library/API documentation lookup, useful when research or design skills need current framework docs.

args: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec; spec = spec_from_file_location('ai_mcp', 'ai-mcp.py'); mod = module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod); mod.mcp.run()
adb-illustrator._note: Lane 3 (Illustrator). NOT a drop-in — this is the MCP-server half only. It also needs the command-proxy server running and the Adobe UXP plugin installed in Illustrator (same machine, Illustrator open). Follow the full 'Installation' section in mcp/adb-mcp/README.md before adding this entry; skip it if you don't need live Illustrator control. Requires 'uv' (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) at the path shown, or adjust 'command' to your uv path.

_optional_advanced.crawl4ai: Lane 1, optional. If you run the same crawl4ai Docker container locally (see ORCA-OS mcp/crawl4ai/), it's an SSE endpoint at http://localhost:11235, not a stdio command — add it via Settings > Connectors as a remote/custom connector rather than this stdio config block. Skip entirely if you don't already run that container; chrome-devtools + WebFetch cover most scraping needs without it.
